result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there is one clear visual defect: in the 'Popular right now' section, the meta line under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' shows overlapping text ('25–30 min' and '€0 delivery' rendered on top of each other), making both unreadable. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, carousel, bottom nav) appear intact; the partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scroll behavior and not reported.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' title, the delivery time text ('25–30 min') and the delivery fee text ('€0 delivery') overlap each other, producing garbled, unreadable text (e.g. '25–3€0 delivery' with strikethrough-like collision).
issues.suggestion: Fix the meta row layout so each meta item occupies its own space: use a horizontal flex row with proper gap/separator between time, fee, and category, and ensure text elements are not absolutely positioned or negatively margined on top of one another.

issues.description: The overlapping meta line also duplicates delivery information already shown as a badge on the card image ('€0 delivery'), which can look redundant once the overlap is fixed.
issues.suggestion: After fixing the overlap, consider showing only one delivery-fee indication per card (badge or meta line) to avoid redundant information.
